title: regional-shedder-fastpath-alignment-and-graceful-unwind
author: Aisha Patel
release_notes: Staggered rollout: opt-in via runtime flag --regional-shedder-alignment; fixes incorrect fastpath routing during transient load spikes. No customer-visible API changes.
description: Context: During a regional overload incident on 2026-02-03 we observed fastpath (low-latency) requests being routed to nodes that were simultaneously executing slowpath KV-drain work. That caused transient SLO violations and prolonged recovery because the shedder's notion of node readiness and the fastpath admission window were out of sync. This PR introduces a compact alignment layer that keeps the fastpath admission window consistent with the regional shedder's soft-evacuation state and adds a graceful unwind sequence to avoid abrupt re-admittance spikes when a region recovers. Motivation: reduce SLO risk during regional failover/evacuation by (1) preventing fastpath from bouncing between nodes with differing readiness signals, (2) smoothing the re-introduction of traffic to repaired nodes, and (3) providing an emergency toggle for rollback/hotfix. What changed (summary): - Introduced region_shedder.FastpathAligner which subscribes to shedder state and exposes a per-route admission override. - Added an unwind timer and token-leak algorithm to stagger re-admit (configurable via shed_policy.yaml). - Tightened the readiness check to include KV-drift and inflight-prefetch counters to avoid accidental fastpath admission. - Added an ops playbook and smoke canary for staged rollout (docs/ops/regional-shedder-md). - Integration tests that simulate concurrent slowpath drain + fastpath spikes. Rollout plan: Feature gated behind --regional-shedder-alignment (off by default). Rollout phases: canary in us-west-2 (10% traffic) -> gradual ramp over 48h with telemetry monitoring (SLO 99th token latency). If anomalies appear, flip runtime flag off and revert via hotfix branch. Linear/Jira: ENG-3245 tracks telemetry thresholds used to validate the ramp. SUP-8831 documents the customer incident that motivated the change. Safety and observations: - Added histogram and event tracing for aligner-decisions so we can debug misalignments quickly. - The unwind uses exponential backoff + jitter to avoid synchronized re-admits. - There is a short-circuit path (runtime emergency toggle) to disable the aligner in case of unforeseen regressions. Testing: - Unit tests for the aligner state machine and token-leak behavior. - Integration test injecting KV-drain delays and asserting no fastpath SLO regressions. - Smoke canary run against a staging cluster; recorded metrics attached in Linear. See CI section for results. Files of interest: service/shedder/aligner.go, controlplane/shed_policy.yaml, service/shedder/readiness_probe.go, tests/integration/test_fastpath_alignment.py, charts/redwood-shedders/values.yaml, docs/ops/regional-shedder.md Commit summary: - a1b2c3: initial FastpathAligner implementation and tests - d4e5f6: integrate aligner with regional shedder state stream - f7a8b9: add unwind sequencing, token-leak algorithm and config knobs - 0a1b2c: add smoke canary docs and rollout recipe - 3d4f5g: tweak readiness thresholds after integration failures Review notes: see review_comments below. CI/Checks: unit-tests: pass; lint: pass; integration-tests: failed on first run due to test flakiness in test_fastpath_alignment.py -> root cause: test harness timing; rerun -> pass; canary-e2e: pass on staging. Merge strategy: squash and merge after approvals; one-line synthesized commit message references ENG-3245. Backout plan: hotfix branch hotfix/regional-shedder-rollback created, contains minimal revert of integration points and adds alert to revert runtime flag. Ops: added playbook step-by-step for manual rollback and recommended thresholds for rollback (5% sustained > SLO breach for 30m).

notes_for_oncall: If post-deploy SLO regressions appear, flip runtime flag --regional-shedder-alignment=false and notify SRE. Watch aligner.event.{drop,admit,unwind} metrics and the 99th token latency per-region. If traffic still leaks into unhealthy nodes, enable hotfix/regional-shedder-rollback and restart ingress pods in affected region.
post_deploy_observations: First 6h: 0.3% improvement in region-wide 99th token latency during small spikes
24h: no regressions observed in canary region; aligner.admit_rate stabilized after unwind window
notes: This PR is intentionally conservative: alignment logic is state-driven and opt-in to minimize blast radius. The main risk is unseen interaction with third-party prefetch behaviors; we added telemetry to detect that quickly.
